what_this_is: Honesty checker: a full-size piece of the 4 x 4 area baked again by me (window [1.5, 1.5, 1], 1254 dots, exact) compared with the same place of the builder's area_4x4 (2508 across, 4 samples, height shrunk to 8-bit, colour JPEG), after averaging my piece 2 x 2. offset_0/offset_1 = the two possible half-dot alignments. The control compares with a place one tile away.
